notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide and docs/evidence/emptystate.md at b4988c5 (“publish nine Component Fix fixes on jfs-components c8526ae”). The guide's Sources note was checked on 23 October 2026 on the 23 October build, which the evidence's c8526ae section names (mirror v0.1.78-c8526ae, Biscuit's main at c8526ae, the #231 fix, verified 23 October), so items citing it carry that build. The evidence's 10 October sections (0.1.78-636f3f5: Contract, Browser measurements, Accessibility, Limits) describe the package before #231 and are out of date where its c8526ae section says so: placeholder copy and a default “Button” that does nothing, null slots that still render the defaults, custom slots that get no modes, no role, heading or name. None of those sentences is used; from the 10 October sections only Figma and token facts still true on the installed build are used (the red capsule's modes, the Emphasis Medium capsule colour, the 81 px L capsule), each resolved again from the installed tokens. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). GitHub's compare of v0.1.78-c8526ae and v0.1.78-dbe0e02 changes no file of EmptyState, IconCapsule, Button, react-utils or the design tokens (Card.tsx does change, #343). Installed EmptyState.tsx matches every guide sentence used here, read from source, not run: title and description default to empty and render only when set (the description also needs showDescription); the icon sits above the title and description, the button below; title 16 px bold (line height 18), description 12 px (16), centred; padding 4, 16 px between icon, title and description, 24 px above the button, no background; width comes from the parent; iconSlot left out gives a default IconCapsule wrapped aria-hidden, a passed node is cloned with Empty State's modes (its own modes win), and null or false removes it; buttonSlot null or false removes the button, a passed node is cloned the same way, and without one a Button with Empty State's modes appears when buttonLabel or onPress is set; the root's accessibility label is accessibilityLabel or the title and its role summary, which react-native-web 0.21.2 renders as a section with role region; the title is a header, rendered as h1 (heading); IconCapsule renders role image and drops any accessibilityLabel, so a passed icon is an unnamed image. Two guide sentences read wider than the code: Content's “shows a button only when you give it a label” and the Don't caption “Without a button label there’s no button”: onPress alone also draws a Button, with an empty label (label={buttonLabel ?? ''}); the Sources sentence (“a label or an action”) is exact. States' “Its button has the usual Button states”: the built-in button takes no disabled, so the Retrying state needs a Button in buttonSlot, as the guide's own Retrying card does. From the source, not run: Card clones its modes into its children and adds AppearanceBrand Neutral (the guide's In context sets it on the Card; on dbe0e02 it is also Card's default), so in the In context card Neutral reaches Empty State, its Icon Capsule and its button: the capsule resolves to grey #545961 (Neutral, Emphasis Medium) and the button to dark grey #303338, not the soft brand icon and gold button the other sections show. No guide sentence covers this, so it is not a rule here; the In context example keeps the guide's composition and says so. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every component and Host). Modes are kept only where an entry rule says the content needs them: the icon's colour follows the reason (Configuration “Pick the icon and its colour for why the area is empty”, the Do “A soft icon for an empty list; red only when something failed”), so the failed case's Icon Capsule keeps Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem negative (the evidence names them for Figma's red capsule; set on the capsule, not on Empty State, whose modes would also reach its button), and the empty-list capsules keep Emphasis Medium, the pale capsule (#fde8c9) the evidence measures for the guide's “Make a payment” composition, against the default gold #cea15a. The soft-icon reading of Emphasis Medium rests on the guide's code and that measurement, not on a sentence that names the mode: an assumption for review. Left out: Icon Capsule Size L on every capsule and Button / Size S on Empty State (no guide rule says this content needs them; Sources describes Figma's 81 px icon and 32 px button, kept as evidence facts; the button is a built-in part, which the building rules keep to its props), and AppearanceBrand Neutral on the Card (Card's default on dbe0e02). IconCapsule has no entry in this pack; the examples use it in iconSlot because the anatomy names the icon as “An Icon Capsule you pass in” and the guide never shows the default icon (as BrandChip's entry uses Avatar in avatarSlot). Copy and data are the guide's own (Recent payments, No payments yet, Couldn’t load payments, ic_wallet, ic_error). Left out of examples (three at most): the No results and Without a description cards (their copy is in content good), the list the In context card swaps in after a payment (ListGroup, ListItem and a MoneyValue, which has no entry) and its Clear payments button (screen state), the readout, the playground, the Host wrapper, testID and the Don'ts. Not recorded: style and testID (the building rules keep style off Coin components), accessibilityRole (the guide doesn't cover overriding it), the evidence's 236 × 211 and 236 × 227 measurements and Figma's unused slot/gap, the Color Mode text colours, and the 10 October line that nothing announces the empty state (pre-#231, not re-checked). Not recorded as gaps, per the pack's rules: dark mode (no background, so the page shows Light only) and the unnamed passed-in icon. #231's problems are fixed and verified on c8526ae, so gaps hold only the Storybook that predates this build. The Sources blocks that end “jfs-components”, “0.1.78”, “null” are the note's code elements; the paragraph itself reads “passing null removes the icon or the button”, so no value is missing. Content bad is empty: the Don'ts show configurations (no button, the error icon on an empty list, no title), not bad wording. Sorting (batch 6), after the cross-check: “red only when something failed” is a Do caption, so it stays recommended, not required; the iconSlot and buttonSlot behaviour items, which rest on facts, are recommended too; the In context example's purpose no longer says the Card's AppearanceBrand Neutral reaches the Empty State (true in the installed Card.tsx, which adds Neutral and passes its modes to its children, but nothing cited says it; it is raised on the guide fix instead); the four mode facts say only what the evidence measures. Second cross-check (batch 6): the Title part no longer says it is not shown when empty (nothing cited says so), and the Button / Size fact no longer gives the 97 × 42 size, which the evidence measured on the old placeholder button.

examples.purpose: An empty payments card, the guide's In context: the Recent payments card shows the Empty State until there's a payment; Make a payment (onPress) adds one, and the screen swaps the Empty State for the list. The icon is the guide's own Nothing yet capsule (ic_wallet with Emphasis Medium, the soft icon for an empty list).
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <Card.Title>Recent payments</Card.Title>
  <EmptyState
    iconSlot={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_wallet" modes={{ Emphasis: 'Medium' }} />}
    title="No payments yet"
    description="Payments you make will show up here."
    buttonLabel="Make a payment"
    onPress={() => {}}
  />
</Card>

from.quote: The Recent payments card shows the empty state until there’s a payment. Make a payment adds one, and the screen swaps the empty state for the list.

examples.purpose: Couldn't load: a red error icon when loading failed (Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem negative, set on the Icon Capsule so the button keeps its own look), and the button retries.
examples.jsx:
<EmptyState
  iconSlot={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_error" modes={{ 'Semantic Intent': 'System', AppearanceSystem: 'negative' }} />}
  title="Couldn’t load payments"
  description="Check your connection and try again."
  buttonLabel="Try again"
  onPress={() => {}}
/>

from.quote: A red error icon when loading failed; the button retries.

examples.purpose: Retrying: while a retry is already running, the button is disabled. Empty State's own button takes no disabled, so a disabled Button goes in buttonSlot, as in the guide's Retrying example; it gets Empty State's modes.
examples.jsx:
<EmptyState
  iconSlot={<IconCapsule iconName="ic_error" modes={{ 'Semantic Intent': 'System', AppearanceSystem: 'negative' }} />}
  title="Couldn’t load payments"
  description="Check your connection and try again."
  buttonSlot={<Button label="Try again" disabled />}
/>

from.quote: Disable the button while a retry is already running.

evidenceFacts.name: title
evidenceFacts.description: On the web, a titled Empty State is a section with role region named by its title (accessibilityRole summary), and the title is a heading (h1).
evidenceFacts.quote: a titled Empty State is `section role="region"` named by its title (`accessibilityRole: 'summary'`); the title is an `h1`.

evidenceFacts.name: accessibilityLabel
evidenceFacts.description: Names the Empty State in place of its title. Without a title and without accessibilityLabel, the Empty State has no role or name.
evidenceFacts.quote: Without a title (and no `accessibilityLabel`) there is no role or name.

evidenceFacts.name: iconSlot
evidenceFacts.description: Left out, the default icon is hidden from screen readers (aria-hidden on the web); an IconCapsule you pass stays an unnamed image (role img).
evidenceFacts.quote: The default icon is wrapped `aria-hidden`; an IconCapsule passed in `iconSlot` stays an unnamed `role="img"`.

evidenceFacts.name: buttonLabel
evidenceFacts.description: With buttonLabel or onPress, and no buttonSlot, Empty State draws a Button that gets its modes; with neither, there is no button.
evidenceFacts.quote: new `buttonLabel` and `onPress` give a default Button (modes from Empty State) only when one of them is set

evidenceFacts.name: iconSlot
evidenceFacts.description: null or false removes the icon; a node you pass gets Empty State's modes, and its own modes win.
evidenceFacts.quote: `iconSlot={null}` / `buttonSlot={null}` (or `false`) remove the slot; custom slots get Empty State's modes through `cloneChildrenWithModes`, and the slot's own `modes` win.

evidenceFacts.name: buttonSlot
evidenceFacts.description: null or false removes the button; a node you pass gets Empty State's modes, and its own modes win.
evidenceFacts.quote: `iconSlot={null}` / `buttonSlot={null}` (or `false`) remove the slot; custom slots get Empty State's modes through `cloneChildrenWithModes`, and the slot's own `modes` win.

evidenceFacts.name: AppearanceSystem
evidenceFacts.description: On the Icon Capsule in iconSlot, Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem negative gives Figma's red error capsule (#f50030). Set on Empty State instead, it would also reach the button.
evidenceFacts.quote: The red capsule plus gold button equals Icon Capsule Size L + System negative on the capsule and Button / Size S + Brand Primary on the button.

evidenceFacts.name: Emphasis
evidenceFacts.description: On the Icon Capsule in iconSlot, Emphasis Medium gives a pale capsule (#fde8c9); the default capsule is gold (#cea15a).
evidenceFacts.quote: `Emphasis: Medium` capsule; Button size S “Make a payment”): 360 × 213; capsule `#fde8c9`

evidenceFacts.name: Icon Capsule Size
evidenceFacts.description: On the Icon Capsule, L is Figma's 81 px capsule with a 36 px icon; the default capsule is 42 px.
evidenceFacts.quote: capsule 81 × 81 red `#f50030` with a 36 px icon

evidenceFacts.name: Button / Size
evidenceFacts.description: The guide sets S on Empty State, whose modes reach its button, for Figma's 32 px button.
evidenceFacts.quote: `ES` passes `buttonLabel` and `onPress` with `Button / Size: S` on Empty State instead of a button slot
